name: claudetv
description: ClaudeTV - player de IPTV pessoal para LG webOS

scripts.pack: npm run build && ares-package app --outdir dist --no-minify
scripts.deploy: npm run pack && ares-install --device tv dist/com.gabriel.claudetv_1.0.0_all.ipk && ares-launch --device tv com.gabriel.claudetv
scripts.publish: npm run build && npm run check && git add -A && git commit -m "claudetv: nova versao" && git push -u origin HEAD
scripts.test:instalar: npm i -D playwright && npx playwright install chromium
